mapper.select: SELECT A.* , SHOPNAME || '_' || TYPE AS "_id" FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT #{FABID} AS SHOPNAME , DECODE(STK_TYP, 'NA', TYPE, STK_TYP) AS TYPE FROM NT_R_MACHINE ) A

SELECT DISTINCT #{FABID} AS FACID , #{FABID} AS MCSFABID , #{FABID} AS SHOPNAME , B.NAME AS "_id" , CASE WHEN B.NAME LIKE '__IO%' THEN 'FIO' ELSE A.MACHINETYPE END AS MACHINETYPE , DECODE(B.TYPE, 'STOCKER', DECODE(B.STK_TYP, 'NA', 'STOCKER', 'NORMAL', 'STOCKER', 'ZIPTOWER', 'LIFTER', 'LIFTER', 'LIFTER', 'INTERLAYER', 'LIFTER', 'PODZIPTOWER', 'LIFTER', 'STOCKER'), 'CONVEYOR', DECODE(B.STK_TYP, 'INTERAILSEMITS', 'CONVEYOR', 'INTERAILSTORAGE', 'CONVEYOR', 'FIO') , B.TYPE) AS TYPE , B.AREANAME , B.BAYNAME , B.MACHINEKIND , #{FABID} || '_' || B.NAME AS "UID" FROM (SELECT MACHINENAME, MACHINETYPE FROM NT_C_SECS WHERE MACHINETYPE != 'VM') A RIGHT JOIN NT_R_MACHINE B ON A.MACHINENAME = B.ID
SELECT DISTINCT NAME AS "_id" , #{FABID} AS FABID , TYPE , ZONENAME FROM NT_R_UNIT

SELECT M.ID, CASE WHEN M.TYPE='STB' THEN 'STBGROUP' WHEN M.TYPE='PROCESS' THEN 'EQP' WHEN M.TYPE='CONVEYOR' THEN 'FIO' WHEN M.TYPE='STOCKER' AND M.STK_TYP='INTERAILSEMITS' THEN 'FIO' WHEN M.TYPE='STOCKER' THEN 'STK' ELSE M.TYPE END EQPTYPE, CASE WHEN N.MACHINENAME IS NULL THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END ISN2, P.PROCESSTYPELIST, M.STK_TYP, DECODE(M.STATE,'INSERVICE','T','F') AVAILABLE, CASE WHEN M.TYPE='STOCKER' AND C.MACHINENAME IS NULL THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END ISVM, M.BAYNAME AS MCSBAYNM FROM NT_R_MACHINE M, NT_E_N2MACHINE N, (SELECT MACHINENAME, LISTAGG(PROCESSTYPENAME,',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY PROCESSTYPENAME) PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_T_MACHINEPROCESSTYPE GROUP BY MACHINENAME) P, NT_C_SECS C WHERE M.ID=N.MACHINENAME(+) AND M.ID=P.MACHINENAME(+) AND M.ID=C.MACHINENAME(+) AND M.TYPE IN ('PROCESS','CONVEYOR','OHT','AGV') AND M.ID NOT LIKE '%\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND M.ID NOT LIKE '%-%' AND M.MACHINEKIND != 'interStorage' AND M.ID NOT IN ('IS7P001S') AND ((M.TYPE IN ('CONVEYOR') AND HANDLETRANSPORTCOMMAND='T') OR M.TYPE NOT IN ('CONVEYOR')) AND ((M.TYPE IN ('LIFTER','STOCKER') AND M.ID IN (SELECT MACHINENAME FROM NT_R_UNIT WHERE unitkind='crane')) or M.TYPE NOT IN ('LIFTER','STOCKER') or (M.TYPE='STOCKER' AND M.STK_TYP='INTERAILSEMITS')) ORDER BY 1
